title: Cyclotomic Newton Expansions and a Rank-Uniform Integer-Valued Newton Completion
summary: Let $J_r^{SU(n)}(K;q)$ denote the reduced $SU(n)$ quantum invariant of a zero-framed knot $K$, colored by the $r$th symmetric power of the defining representation and normalized to be $1$ for the unknot. For every fixed $n\ge2$ we prove the Chen--Liu--Zhu cyclotomic expansion conjecture: there are unique coefficients $H_k^{(n)}(K;q)\in\mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm1}]$ such that \[ J_r^{SU(n)}(K;q)=\sum_{k=0}^{r} \left(\prod_{i=0}^{k-1}\{r-i\}\{r+n+i\}\right) H_k^{(n)}(K;q), \] where $\{m\}=q^m-q^{-m}$.
